ai_summary: Agarwal Industrial Corporation has informed stock exchanges of its compliance with SEBI regulations by digitally distributing its FY 2025-26 Annual Report to shareholders and announcing a virtual 32nd Annual General Meeting for September 24, 2026. The communication critically emphasizes the need for shareholders to update KYC details and dematerialize physical holdings, warning that non-compliant physical shareholders will only receive payments electronically, effective April 1, 2024. This highlights a potential ongoing administrative challenge concerning shareholder data and engagement, implying a significant number of shareholders may face payment issues.
